title: Phase 4 red run and green result
observation: Red commit b5783e4 holds only test/unit/presentation-manager.spec.ts and test/mocks/context.ts. Running `jest test/unit/presentation-manager.spec.ts` against the phase-3 source gave 6 failed and 100 passed tests: full update, size-only update, clamping, the throttled broadcast (both publishData and updateMetadataState), and get-state carrying the default overlay. The invalid-input, empty-command and stop-while-pending cases pass trivially in red, because the base source ignores the unknown command. The hook accepted the test-only red commit without src stubs. Green commit d7b028d: the file passes 106/106, the full suite passes 291 across 14 suites, and lint, typecheck, the lockfile check, and both the phase and Completion `rg` checks are clean.
conclusion: The overlay command tests use fake timers with `doNotFake: ['setImmediate', 'nextTick']`, so `flushMicrotasks` still works. They also live in their own top-level describe with the default renderer (no slide videos), which means the 3000 ms preDownloadTimer does nothing when timers advance.

title: End-to-end manual smoke skipped: no dev LiveKit room
observation: The plan's Completion smoke needs a dev LiveKit room and a sites streamer view with frontend phase 1: bubble bottom-left with the camera on before start, `presentation:overlay:update` moving it on slides and on playing and paused video, and camera-off hiding it. The executor had neither the room nor the frontend build, so the smoke did not run. Other behaviours are covered only by unit tests with a mocked publisher and overlay: an overlay update does not push a frame, and it relies on the next camera or ffmpeg frame to apply.
conclusion: Before merging, run the plan's manual smoke on a dev room. Pay particular attention to a layout change while paused with an active camera, which should apply on the next camera frame (≤50 ms).
